data.long_meaning: Rukhailah is derived from the Arabic word 'Rukh' meaning 'high' and 'Alah' meaning 'God'. This name signifies a noble and exalted person, one who is close to God and strives to live a high and noble life. The name Rukhailah carries the meaning “High, noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. historical_references.reference: Rukhailah ibn fihr al-Ghassani, was the last Zaidite imam and the founder of the Rukhailid dynasty, which ruled over Yemen from 820 CE to 1062 CE.
historical_references.context: Rukhailah led a series of successful military campaigns against the Abbasid Caliphate and established the independent Zaidite state in Yemen.

historical_references.reference: Rukhailah ibn Rabi'ah, one of the companions of the Prophet Muhammad, was known for his generosity and piety. He is mentioned in various hadiths and is considered a role model for Muslims in matters of charity and hospitality.
historical_references.context: Rukhailah was a wealthy merchant who used his wealth to help the poor and needy, and his hospitality was renowned in Medina.
